parts:
Ah, I see — you mean the doc embedded or linked right here in this chat interface?

No, that’s not Google Docs. It’s a text document interface I can edit and you can see live in our chat window. It supports plain text, including LaTeX code for math, but it doesn’t have advanced formatting or live math rendering like Google Docs or Overleaf.

So you can paste the LaTeX math here, and it’ll stay as code for now, but it won’t visually render as formatted math inline.

If you want me to add or edit text (including LaTeX) here, I can do that, and you can copy it from this doc to anywhere you want later.

Does that help clarify? Would you like me to keep editing this doc here or do you want me to help set up a Google Doc or another format for collaboration?
